messages:
Lucy: Quick sync: Concord wants a joint launch for their Gateway + our LlamaIndex adapter. Need owners, embargo, and a demo plan.
Concord PM: Target week 2024-09-16. We can supply logo + 1-line. Would like a marketplace tile and a short demo.
Maria: I'll own marketplace tile + submission. Need the 1-line and logo assets by 2024-08-20.
Sanjay: Eng can build a reference adapter and sample app. Blocker: SSO metadata and the adapter spec.
Andrew: DevEx will draft quickstart and a 3-min demo script. Will want sample payloads and a curl example.
Eve (Legal): Send proposed joint text and any perf claims. I need to review marketplace copy before publish.
Lucy: Rehearsal plan: dry run 2024-09-13, final 2024-09-15, publish 2024-09-16. Integrations-bot add checklist?
integrations-bot: Added cards: ["SSO creds"], ["Adapter spec"], ["Quickstart draft"], ["Marketplace copy"], ["Legal review"].
Maria: I'll upload draft copy 2024-08-20 and ping for review.
Sanjay: If we advertise "plug-and-play" we'll produce a short compatibility matrix for model variants by 2024-09-06.
Lucy: Owners recap: Maria=marketplace, Sanjay=adapter & compat, Andrew=quickstart, Eve=legal, Lucy=partner runway. Concord PM: please send assets.
Concord PM: Sending logos and embargo ack now. Thanks everyone.
